steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 protect individuals' personal data. Organisations must have a lawful basis to process data and must obtain consent in most cases. | Key Fact: Individual rights under UK GDPR: right of access, right to rectification, right to erasure (right to be forgotten), right to restrict processing, right to data portability, and right to object. | Key Fact: The Online Safety Act 2023 requires platforms to protect users from harmful content, especially children. Ofcom has enforcement powers including fines of up to 10% of global revenue. | Key Fact: Freedom of expression online is protected by Article 10 ECHR but has limits: hate speech, harassment, defamation, incitement to violence, and terrorism promotion are illegal.
